boundary: ZERO model, server, encoder, embedder, scorer, network, GPU and paid-API contacts: no server was started, stopped or probed, no waveform decoded and no embedding computed. Every number is arithmetic over receipt-pinned vector files and frozen snapshots, each verified against its configured sha256 by this repository's own loaders through its own rails.phase_supply / rails.knowledge_provider / rails.kb_policy seams. A DERIVATION, never a gate: it registers no cell by itself, admits no mechanism, releases no store, authorises no flight and states no effectiveness, superiority or generalisation claim. Every roster is a discovery or dev roster and every number is a development number (owner decisions 28 and 86). No utterance text, transcript, gold label, intent name, knowledge body or delivered answer is printed or persisted: every cell is an id, a count, a rate or a hash.
gold_use: THE ROSTER IS SELECTED USING GOLD, OFFLINE. The bad-case bank's plan_class and each row's gold intent are read on the scoring side only, in this derivation, before the cell exists. That is legitimate for a CONDITIONAL estimate on a TRAIN roster and for nothing else: NO POOLED OR ROSTER-LEVEL CLAIM MAY EVER BE MADE FROM THE CELL THIS ROSTER DEFINES, because its population was chosen by the mechanism's own effect. Gold reaches no query, no key, no weight, no selector and no runtime.

population.predicate: plan_class == 'INTENT-UNCOVERED' and the row's own gold intent's intent-boundary value id is in the w_agree 1.0 fused selection and NOT in the w_agree 0.0 fused selection, both at recall width 60 with fuse_coverage m 8 / c 1 / top_l 8 -- the receipt's own tally predicate.

compared_exactly: by_recall_width.60.delivery (all six classes, both definitions, plan_class_split, sealed_boundary_agreement, skipped, fusion_vs_rank_disagreements)

roster.id_list_convention: sha256 over the LF-joined sorted sample ids, UTF-8, no trailing newline
roster.split_identity_convention: data.splits.split_identity_hash over the LF-joined sorted carrier-prefixed ids f'slurp/{sample_id}'

the_quantity_this_roster_measures.name: P(correct | newly delivered)
the_quantity_this_roster_measures.re_declared_expectation_rule: re-declared expected_effect_pp of the 1,080-row AGREE arm = (rows of this roster that move from a wrong intent to the gold intent) x 0.041615 pp SLU-F1, and x 0.092615 pp intent accuracy.
the_quantity_this_roster_measures.the_only_directly_observable_prior: 86 of the 191 intent-wrong Fold A rows already RECEIVE the gold intent's boundary entry in the sealed comparator and are intent-wrong anyway (the agreement package's own measured_inputs), so the only directly observable conversion evidence on this population is zero. That is a reason to measure the factor, not a prediction of it.
the_quantity_this_roster_measures.what_it_is: the agreement arm's PERSUASION factor, the one term of its declared expectation that is not measured. Every one of these rows is intent WRONG in the sealed comparator (INTENT-UNCOVERED collapses to INTENT-WRONG in the bank's own convention), so the forward count is the whole estimate and the reverse count on this population is zero by construction.

why: The committed replication receipt records the COUNT of newly delivered INTENT-UNCOVERED rows (70 of 130, 0 lost) and carries NO row ids, so the probe's roster cannot be read off it. It is RECONSTRUCTED here by importing that receipt's own recipe byte-unchanged and calling its own functions with its own parameters, and the reconstruction is PROVEN by reproducing every cell the receipt committed for this arm at this width -- the whole delivery block, both boundary-channel pin blocks, the bank digest, the builder digest, the sealed phase-artefact digest, the split identity and the roster row count -- before a single id is taken.
